What is your own experience with hypnosis? Do you even think it's real?
What is your (good or bad) experience with hypnosis?
Tried it a couple times, for various reasons. I think it only works to a certain extent, and only if you're willing.

A buddy of mine tried to hypnotize me, but either he wasn't very good at it or I just wasn't as "open" to it as I thought, cause ... nothing. Bohonkey. I sincerely believe that it's fake and play acted up by people that enjoy being the center of attention - but then I'm not an "open" mind I guess.

I have experienced it, and genuinely thought I was unintentionally faking until one point when it was like floodgates opened. It was therapy so no audience of course, and an extremely internal experience.

I have heard that some people can't be hypnotized, and I completely agree. It is more like being guided than having someone controlling the experience.

It's a great stress reliever if nothing else. When I was young I listened to an audio file that was said to increase brain power to the point of being able to move things with my mind and remember a lot more. I think what it did most was boost my self-confidence, which in turn made me better. So I was happy.

Sadly no telekinesis powers yet, though.

That would be pretty bad ass.

Why do you think it increased your confidence? It certainly helped mine! I figure it had to do with self reflection more than anything.

I'm usually a very jaded person, never believing anything I can't touch or logically deduce. But for some reason, I had convinced myself that I really wanted hypsosis to work, because I wanted to become better.

I think it was mostly that I convinced myself that my brain was amazing, that I actually could remember better, and learn better. It made me pay attention to all the times I actually remembered things, realize how to pay attention, and learn how to teach myself things better. So in a sense, the hypnosis worked indirectly, at least for giving me a heightened brainpower. Sometimes I still feel like I remember way too much. But then I'm also very absentminded. So I have a better long term memory, than short term, oddly enough.

I have no real frame of reference for how much other people actually remember things, so I could still just be tricking myself into believing that it worked. :P

I think it's real, just exaggerated. I know how to induct someone into hypnosis, and I think I've done it in the past, although people may have just been indulging me. I know a couple party tricks for once someone's 'under' but that's about it.

I had a thing where a hypnotist tried to do it on me and a bunch of other people. I played along with it till the end then sat back down, wasn't really hypnotized. Later, everyone didn't believe me when I said I was just playing along instead of actually being hypnotized. I really doubt it's a real thing but I was more surprised by how people didn't believe me when I told them that I was just pretending.
